title: The router is live
text: q2q serve took over from the starter on the laptop. Champion baseline, explore 3%.

title: rules is the first champion
text: Promoted after 8 minutes: about +16 against the baseline in its first block.

title: Outage over: 44 minutes on the fallback
text: The laptop went into standby at 14:20. Router and logger resumed on their own at wake-up.

title: rules2 promoted to champion
text: Weights re-measured on live feedback. Two block pairs: mean +24.8 against +16.5 for rules.

title: rules3 dropped
text: About 6 points behind rules2. The steeper favourite-category effect hurts when the shopper has recent views.

title: Home requests get their own arm: cold1
text: cold1 answers requests without recent views, two blocks on and two off.

title: First trained model live: ranker
text: LightGBM on 601,187 live impressions, on 25% of ordinary requests, retrained every 20 minutes.

title: ranker promoted to champion
text: It led rules2 in two 30-minute windows: 1.54% against 1.29% for returning shoppers, 2.41% against 2.29% for new shoppers.

title: cold1 retired
text: 0.29-0.40% on home requests, no better than rules2. The real signal on the home page is the cart: cold2 takes its place.

title: rules4 and cold2 in test
text: rules4 on a third of ordinary requests: the first recent view leads. cold2 on half of home requests: history carts lead.

title: The operator runs
text: Every 15 minutes it reads the last hour per model, drops arms 2 standard errors behind and promotes a challenger that keeps winning.

title: ranker2 in test
text: The ranker plus 13 inputs from the wide-feature study, on a third of ordinary requests. Offline top-3 share 74% against 57%.

title: rules4 is champion, ranker2 the only challenger
text: rules4 led three windows (1.81% over 1,012 requests). ranker and rules2 are out, cold2 takes all home requests, explore down to 2%.

title: History pretraining: no gain
text: History rows in ranker2's training, tested five ways: top-3 share 72.2% against 71.4%, inside the noise. Left off.

title: Online research finished
text: Diversity is worth almost nothing at our purchase rates. Better candidates and fitting the simulator's own form matter more.

title: Building a replay evaluator
text: Replays logged requests through a strategy so an idea can be filtered in minutes before it gets live traffic.

title: Building linear1, a log-linear fit
text: Fits the simulator's scoring form directly on our feedback.

title: Gap study finished: today's carts are the biggest miss
text: A product carted today converts at 6.4% per impression for new shoppers, against 1.2% for the first view.

title: rules5 live on a third of ordinary requests
text: rules4 plus the gap study, with all of today's carts in the state.

title: Replay evaluator ready
text: Scores any strategy on logged requests in about 2 minutes. Its filter metric orders ranker2, rules4, rules2 and ranker exactly as the live board did. Offline, ranker2 also looks best on the home page.

title: VM shadow run started
text: The router runs on the VM in shadow mode: it computes answers and writes nothing. First minutes: zero late answers, 488 MB.

title: ranker2 on half of home requests
text: The evaluator ranks it best on the home page offline. It now shares home requests with cold2.

title: Simulator fit: no clean formula, linear1 gets no traffic
text: A simple multiplicative model ranks the bought product in the top 3 in 62% of cases, ranker2 in 74%. Confirmed: clicks grow faster than popularity, and the cart effect exists only for shoppers who cart often.
